other_failure_modes.name: Missing target decoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent encodes target labels into integers (0, 1, ...) for training but fails to decode the predictions back to their original label values before writing the submission. If the original labels are strings or non-sequential integers, the submission will have the wrong format.

other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates submission IDs using a simple range (np.arange) instead of extracting the actual ID column from the test dataset. If the test IDs do not start at 0 or are not strictly sequential, the submission will be misaligned.

summary: The agent sets up a robust validation and evaluation pipeline using cross-validation and scikit-learn Pipelines, successfully avoiding data leakage. However, it entirely skips feature engineering and relies solely on accuracy without checking for class imbalance. Most critically, the code has severe flaws in generating the submission file: it hardcodes the ID column as a simple sequence and fails to inverse-transform the encoded target integers back to their original labels.
